mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates expanding labor market conditions and corporate hiring, directly supporting higher corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that precedes stronger corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5.0% for two consecutive months, the 5-day forward return is negative.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction between HOUST and RSAFS (both rising) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), a year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 2.0% signals persistent inflation and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the central bank's hawkish stance dampens risk appetite.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY increase > 2.0%, the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector and potential economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, the 5-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth in the current quarter fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 45% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25pp in a month, the 20-day forward return is positive.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates a monetary policy response to inflation, typically leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates growth-inflation balance.
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise (both occurring in the same month) fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.05.
